title: AgenticMCP/llm-training-toolkit
summary: AgenticMCP/llm-training-toolkit是一个用于理解和实验大型语言模型训练和微调的项目，支持多种架构。该项目提供了模型训练、推理、算法和架构优化等功能，适用于需要高性能和可扩展性的语言模型训练场景。
description: A learning project for understanding and experimenting with large language model training and fine-tuning across different architectures.
